        <payload><?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update sys_domain="global" table="catalog_script_client"><catalog_script_client action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><active>true</active><applies_catalog>true</applies_catalog><applies_extended>false</applies_extended><applies_req_item>true</applies_req_item><applies_sc_task>true</applies_sc_task><applies_target_record>true</applies_target_record><applies_to>set</applies_to><cat_item/><cat_variable>IO:dc97a35387e9c2507f7d20e5cebb3583</cat_variable><condition/><description/><field/><global>true</global><isolate_script>true</isolate_script><messages/><name>SelectChoice</name><order/><published_ref/><script><![CDATA[function onChange(control, oldValue, newValue, isLoading) {
    if (isLoading || newValue == '') {
        return;
    }
    g_form.setVisible('email_address_to_send_the_access_procedure', false);
    g_form.setVisible('phone_number_to_reach_the_person', false);
    g_form.setVisible('will_the_person_be_working_outside_of_canada_or_the_united_states', false);
    g_form.setVisible('employee_ou_guests', false);
    g_form.setVisible('user_choices_in_servicenow', false);
    g_form.setVisible('provide_the_guest_s_name_and_email_address', false);
    g_form.clearValue('email_address_to_send_the_access_procedure');
    g_form.clearValue('phone_number_to_reach_the_person');
    g_form.clearValue('will_the_person_be_working_outside_of_canada_or_the_united_states');
    g_form.clearValue('user_choices_in_servicenow');
    g_form.clearValue('provide_the_guest_s_name_and_email_address');
    g_form.setMandatory('email_address_to_send_the_access_procedure', false);
    g_form.setMandatory('will_the_person_be_working_outside_of_canada_or_the_united_states', false);
    g_form.setMandatory('user_choices_in_servicenow', false);
    g_form.setMandatory('provide_the_guest_s_name_and_email_address', false);

    if (newValue == 'new') {
		 g_form.setVisible('provide_the_guest_s_name_and_email_address', false);
        g_form.setVisible('email_address_to_send_the_access_procedure', true);
        g_form.setMandatory('email_address_to_send_the_access_procedure', true);
		g_form.setVisible('phone_number_to_reach_the_person', true);
		g_form.setVisible('will_the_person_be_working_outside_of_canada_or_the_united_states', true);
        g_form.setMandatory('will_the_person_be_working_outside_of_canada_or_the_united_states', true);
		g_form.setVisible('user_choices_in_servicenow', false);
    } else if (newValue == 'existing_employee') {
		 g_form.setVisible('email_address_to_send_the_access_procedure', false);
		 g_form.setVisible('provide_the_guest_s_name_and_email_address', false);
		  g_form.setVisible('will_the_person_be_working_outside_of_canada_or_the_united_states', false);
		  g_form.setVisible('phone_number_to_reach_the_person', false);
        g_form.setVisible('user_choices_in_servicenow', true);
        g_form.setMandatory('user_choices_in_servicenow', true);
    } else if (newValue == 'guest') {
		g_form.setVisible('email_address_to_send_the_access_procedure', false);
		g_form.setVisible('will_the_person_be_working_outside_of_canada_or_the_united_states', false);
		g_form.setVisible('user_choices_in_servicenow', false);
		g_form.setVisible('phone_number_to_reach_the_person', false);
        g_form.setVisible('provide_the_guest_s_name_and_email_address', true);
        g_form.setMandatory('provide_the_guest_s_name_and_email_address', true);

    }
}
